method: Local x86 emulation of original locality function with a read-only source table lookup stub, compared with ukinfo_reader.modern_reader.location for every one-based place ID.
comparison: Locality, town and county strings, bounded to the declared 30-byte text field. The Python reader flags full-width source text instead of reading adjacent metadata.
runtime_dependencies: Emulation tools are used for local research only; the Python reader has no third-party runtime dependencies.
